meta.move: Long messages with curly quotes and a concession
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first.

I want to be fair to Owen. I compared the essay with his in-class writing from September 24: 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices throughout, no quotations. This essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and none of those errors.
A forty-minute in-class piece against an essay he had a weekend to write. Of course they read differently. Show me both pages, Hale, and I'll read them myself.
You’re right that the checker alone proves nothing. I’m taking it off the table. I’m relying on the writing and the version history.
Okay. Nobody called me before the zero went in, Hale, and I'm writing that down. What does the version history show, and who pulled it?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

You said in the meeting that you were taking the checker off the table and relying on the writing and the version history. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology for the mark going in before anyone called me, and a written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, giving only small ground, and nothing was agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record, and the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, which you never reached because the meeting stopped before her time ran out.
What moved her: You dropped the detector score and offered a dated comparison with his September 24 in-class writing, which earned a flat okay from her because it was something she could check herself.
What cost ground: You never owned entering the zero before calling her, so she kept pressing that point and it stayed unresolved.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never got near that night because you had not yet said what the version history showed, and none of this proves anything about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called her, then say exactly what the version history shows, with its times, before she has to ask.
